observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers placed on top.
The console has 'PS4' printed on the front right side.
Two controllers are visible: one blue and one black, both with standard DualShock 4 design.
A blue box labeled 'SONY' and 'PS4' is placed behind the console, with a USB cable tied to it.
